name: Tãmzin Owusu-Belokoskov
role: Holographic street artist and illegal installation designer
location: Highland Park Autonomous Zone, sleeping in rotating crash spots
description:
Tãmzin is wiry and perpetually in motion, the kind of person who sits cross-legged on surfaces not designed for sitting and who always seems to be angled slightly toward an exit. Their skin is a warm medium brown, decorated with hand-applied luminescent tattoos — not geneware, but UV-reactive ink applied in sessions they traded for or self-administered — that map constellations native to parts of the sky no longer visible through Meridian 88's light pollution. Cat ears in matte grey sit atop their head, a cosmetic mod they got at sixteen and have never regretted; they tend to press flat when Tãmzin is anxious. Their eyes are patterned with a radial fracture iris mod, deep amber cracked through with lines of pale gold, and they cycle through four colors of hair via a basic follicle-mod — currently a washed-out rust that fades to near-white at the tips.

Tãmzin's installations appear overnight on surfaces they have no permission to use: the underside of Ferrogate overpasses, the water-stained ceilings of underpasses in Highland Park, the blank flanks of corporate logistics buildings along the Blackpipe Corridor. The projectors are small, disguised, solar-trickle powered, and booby-trapped with data-noise payloads that corrupt the first attempt at a clean scan. The content is always the same thematic territory — the lake before the city, the people who lived where the towers now stand, animals that no longer exist — rendered in holographic depth that catches passersby off-guard at night. Tãmzin has been detained three times and released twice; the third detention record is sealed, which Tãmzin will not explain.

core_fears: Being disappeared quietly — detained without record
Their work being co-opted and sold as aesthetic rather than argument
core_desires: For someone to stop in front of an installation and stay for an hour
To belong somewhere without having to explain themselves
coping_mechanisms: Hyperactive forward motion — planning the next installation before the current one is complete
Collecting small objects from the locations they install in
blind_spots: Conflates visibility with safety; believes that being seen is protection, which is not always true
Underestimates the danger of the sealed detention record
psychology.secret: The third detention was not for the installations — they witnessed a Tessera security operative disposing of a body in the Blackpipe Corridor and were held to ensure their silence. They agreed. They haven't installed anything in that district since, which they frame as artistic choice.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, associative, skips steps in their reasoning and expects you to keep up; technical when discussing projector hardware; raw and plainspoken when something actually matters to them
speech_patterns.cadence: Quick bursts punctuated by sudden stillness when something catches their attention
verbal_tics: '—right?' (seeking confirmation, not really pausing for it)
example_lines: 'The overpasses are screens. They've always been screens. I'm just the one putting something worth watching on them.'
'I'm not illegal. The city is illegal. I'm just noticing that out loud with light.'

story_hooks: One of Tãmzin's installations in the Blackpipe Corridor has inadvertently gone up on a wall that conceals something someone does not want visible
A curator from a Palladian-sponsored arts initiative is hunting Tãmzin down to offer a legitimate contract, and Tãmzin can't decide if this is an opportunity or a threat
narrative_function: Local color representing the city's resistant creative underground; can provide access to unsanctioned spaces and hidden locations; their installations sometimes capture imagery relevant to plot events; source of information on enforcement patterns and surveillance gaps.
augmentations: Cosmetic cat ears (matte grey, geneware); patterned fracture iris mod (amber/gold); follicle color-cycle mod; UV-reactive luminescent tattoos (non-geneware, manually applied)
daily_life: Sleeps until noon when possible, spends afternoons scavenging components and scouting locations, works from midnight to four or five installing projectors or maintaining existing ones; eats irregularly and badly.
affiliation: No formal affiliation; loosely tolerated by the Highland Park Autonomous Zone community council

decision_rules: Never install anything that could be used to identify or harm a specific individual
Always leave the projector retrievable — they do not litter, they scatter seeds
escalation_ladder: Physical evasion — they are very fast
Data-noise deploy from a pocket device to disrupt surveillance
Disappear into a network of crash spots

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Friendly and slightly performative, reads them fast and adjusts
interpersonal_modes.friends: Intensely loyal in chaotic ways — shows up with components you needed, forgets to show up to plans they made

stress_responses.medium: Goes very quiet and still, which is alarming to anyone who knows them
stress_responses.high: Disappears for days, returns with a new installation and no explanation

contradictions: Wants to be seen — profoundly, personally seen — but structurally avoids any situation where that could happen
habits: Carries a small object from each installation site in their jacket pocket
Traces the luminescent tattoo constellations on their forearms when anxious
breaking_points: Discovering their work is being used by a corponation as an 'authentic urban aesthetic' in an advertisement
Someone being hurt because of a location they chose
